column4: AVMA gallery JS; investigator primary lists current studies, but entire registry oncology roster cannot be obtained from permitted public master/gallery routes.
Only oncology card is explicitly an AI-generated SAMPLE lymphoma study; rejected as a real treatment opportunity.
41 institution/provider links are a source directory, not 41 current protocols; no complete protocol roster published here.
Palbociclib solid tumors; current master and individual primary agree with canonical.

Twelve legacy oncology titles on Flint master; current StudyPages portal cannot expose its entire roster through master/Web. Six old active primary protocols recovered through public content route; eight cost/eligibility details adjudicated separately, no invented closure from index absence.
Trametinib oral SCC and SmartStart B-cell lymphoma; current master matches canonical.
Cerumen lymphoma diagnostic sampling, excluded from treatment matching.
Five CIGAT programs plus VCTN PET and IF7-SN38 metastatic/brain cohorts; IF7 primary recovered but enrollment/owner benefit/funding and final participating sites not sufficiently defined.
Current clinical-trial index contains no oncology protocol.
CHOP/LOPP, CMP002, Quasi hemangiosarcoma, MCT steroids, feline miR10b; current titles reconciled to canonical.
Eleven named cohorts; LEAH institution-on-hold conflicts with sponsor recruitment. Brain, oral AAV and feline mammary primary reread; conflict preserved.
Twelve named current/closed protocols; LEAH institution-on-hold conflicts with sponsor. No activation or closure inferred from conflict.

Seven dog/cat oncology protocols. XCSgel primary confirms funded surgery+radiation. PIVOT-C primary confirms pilot injections and 28-day surgery/radiation prohibition; costs and controlling owner-benefit qualification unresolved, existing record preserved pending sufficient correction.
Eight institutional protocols; SBRT stabilization, MIC-NK and oral melanoma primaries reread and consistent.
CHOP microbiome observational study; not an independent anticancer treatment trial.
Six reachable oncology archive records, five recruiting labels; main route fails and archive pagination prevents proof of entire roster. FLASH, PSMA and osteosarcoma iNKT primaries read.
Ten named identities in six official disease-category pages. Lymphoma page describes additional ongoing studies without full identities; do not equate observed list with complete roster.
Four oncology entries: active thyroid diagnostic study and three past studies; no new matchable therapy.
Eight named oncology programs; complete current multi-institution/cohort rosters and some funding not published. Z007 and metastatic OSA primaries reread.
VCCT portal JS yields no complete trial list; official alternatives and Web do not independently establish current roster.
Six current plus closed Biocera program; oral melanoma primary reread. Some vaccine cohorts/site rosters not fully published.
Feline oral SCC mRNA treatment protocol, existing canonical match.
Current OPEN B-cell IVP and OPEN sorafenib/placebo plus standard radiation for pituitary macroadenoma; latter added. Complete IVP multicenter roster is not published.
Nine current oncology protocols; eight existing titles plus Daunomustine. Individual primary PDF confirms efficacy-directed therapy, L-asparaginase rescue, funding and eligibility.
Actual master shell attempt returned CONNECT 403; subsequent automatic approval review prohibited this action, no Web switching or repeat. Same attempt is shared as Mars official fallback provenance.

Four programs. Current CED primary does NOT say closed; old concluded label belongs to feline cardiac study. CED exclusion for previous radiation added. Full separate histotripsy cohort/arms are not published clearly.
Institution master and official Patients Needed route return 403; no repeat or access bypass.

Eight master identities plus current recruiting temozolomide/propranolol HSA on direct investigator registry. Current institution/registry difference retained; whole individual cohort roster cannot be established.
Old Ethos master 404, coordinating Ethos Discovery and direct protocol routes reviewed with shared current provenance. Their combined list is not proof of complete Ethos umbrella roster.

Nine named identities, MIMIC phases grouped by real-world identity. Entire published MIMIC two-site and PUSH twelve-site rosters reconciled; Akron direct current primary adds a thirteenth PUSH site and sponsor omission is recorded.
EGFR/HER2 melanoma primary roster reconciled: nine active and three not-enrolling sites; official narrative still says ten active. No fabricated ten-site roster.
TCE current at VRCCO, historical Paccal feline/dog and completed gefitinib; WSU current participation unavailable. Same registry 534230 proves TCE duplicate identity.
SINE with carboplatin after OSA amputation; current sponsor primary consistent with canonical.

Current entire canine index has eight programs, feline index adds porphysome oral SCC and shares biobank. Nine distinct identities: HIFU OSA, Palladia melanoma, urinary miRNA, oral photogrammetry, biobank, T-cell lymphoma prognosis, canine PDT ON HOLD, thyroid staining ON HOLD, feline PDT. No new trial; diagnostic/observational entries excluded.
Twenty-nine registry entries grouped to twenty-seven protocol identities; provider statuses/primary completeness vary, no blanket recruiting claim.
Twenty-four published protocol identities; RVC route blocked and several old listings lack current primary enrollment. Entire seven-site insulinoma roster compared to existing canonical.

OSA oncolytic virus access, holmium brain tumor and feline SCC programs. OSA study full but treatment access may continue, existing separate access preserved; current complete cohort terms not published.
Nine current general/oncology programs; current official inline protocol descriptions and recent primary evidence match.
OncoFAP-MMAE phase I/II watchlist; no defined standard-treatment backbone/owner therapeutic benefit, remains non-matchable.
RVC master shell/Web 403. Official fallback actual timeout was followed by automatic review rejection for prohibited retry; no additional transport or authorization bypass.
CHOP probiotic supportive study; not a new anticancer protocol. Prior pain-study disappearance is not closure evidence.
OSA, PetCure closed, MCT Imprimed hold, feline lymphoma diagnostic program. Published OSA multicenter primary details remain incomplete.
Official page explicitly has no active enrolling studies.
Neobladder protocol is dated 2018; no sufficient current enrollment/owner access confirmation.
Four immunotherapy program identities including Atherton research; cohort access and whole current rosters incompletely published.
Two-vaccine OSA trial before amputation, current institution and protocol consistent.
Same two-vaccine OSA protocol; shared current evidence explicitly reused, no second trial record.
Personalized mRNA MCT expression of interest lacks final approved patient cohort/site/owner access terms.
PetTrials master is JS shell; permitted Web yields no full current search results; not verified zero.
Exercise observational example and MCT drug example; latter lacks confirmed current enrollment details.
Auranofin guide is historical 2013; no current official entry/cohort confirmation.
Hemangiosarcoma autovaccine alongside standard doxorubicin confirmed; vaccine free but standard care owner-paid. Complete participating-center roster not published.
BVSC Foundation master unreadable by permitted shell/Web methods; no source roster established.
Science Week/news material and member repository do not publish owner-access trial roster. No login attempted.
Nine research identities: current gold/SCC carboplatin/EGFR plus past/upcoming work. EGFR entire twelve-site list matched; complete current owner access for other program cohorts not published.
Current sponsor press pages: feline and canine Paccal recruitment completed; Cantrixil preclinical. Already non-matchable; no newly inferred closure.
HS CAR-T early safety/dose research; owner-benefit rule keeps watchlist non-matchable.
Eight research cohorts; EGFR twelve-location/nine-active roster reconciled, other cohort access/location terms incompletely published.
TCE active, Paccal feline and dog historical/closed. Same 534230 registry identifies WSU duplicate; WSU participation not currently reconfirmed.
WSU master/fallback unavailable; current TCE primary shell timeout and Web 403. No repeat after 403, no closure inferred.

Hayburn feline small-cell GI lymphoma radiation plus direct GI-lab MCT study. MCT placebo/acid-suppressant cytotoxic research includes standard resection and $1,000 surgical credit; treatment benefit retained.
Three oncology drug programs (MCT, OSA, oral SCC) without complete public protocol identities/nationwide roster.
mRNA investigator-initiated program claims nine cities/twelve hospitals but does not publish all hospital identities.
ReachGlio SNG-RTNF plus temozolomide current protocol, existing canonical match.
NCI official master returns 403. Search snippets do not establish current whole COTC roster; no repeat after block.
Six current inline Japanese protocol descriptions read; historical bladder recruitment end/paid access preserved distinctly.
September 30 PD-1 signal and three hospital names; primary lacks final current cohort eligibility/owner access details.
CD20, blood research, PD-1, unnamed virus and unnamed drug programs; blank protocol sections prevent full clinical qualification.
Organoid research and IDO1 program; same-day Tokyo primary reused with explicit provenance.
Dog anti-PD1 umbrella, cat PD1, CD20 lymphoma, HIFU title and supplementary PetVoice program; full subgroup/site terms not published. 2025 feline subsidy date is not today enrollment evidence.
VetTrials directory shell lacks readable current program roster; Web alternatives insufficient.
PET/RNA and two radiation-related diagnostic/staging protocols; individual primaries show diagnostic focus, not anticancer treatment trial access.
Official trial page explicitly says no current enrolling studies.
JVCOG professional attestation yes/no gate; no credentials or false professional affirmation used. Accessible leaf insufficient.
NDV melanoma, GM-CSF preclinical and feline lymphoma research descriptions lack confirmed current owner entry.
Personalized canine treatment 2021–2027 and BCNU brain project ended March 2026; whole current owner cohort access undefined.
Stale Paccal owner recruitment pages contradicted by current sponsor completed-recruitment announcements; both already hidden, no new closure.
Estima generic clinical-research description publishes no enumerable current trials.
CD200AR-L OSA alongside standard amputation; current program confirmed but full managed site roster not public.
Colorectal observational study, legacy TG6002 and CARBOPOP ended 2022. Current TG6002 patient access not sufficiently published.
Biocera/Oniris historical multicenter bone-cement work; current full participating enrollment roster not confirmed.
Perseus T-cell infusion program and old trial-discovery material; new public searches performed, originating protocol/status/costs needed. Secondary discovery alone cannot activate treatment.
Four pipeline/research identities including cat melanoma; no sufficiently defined current owner-access cohorts.
Elenagen historical pilot without current patient enrollment/location confirmation.
Cancer Vet generic trial service has no named enumerable current oncology protocols.
Thirty-three resources are directory links, not thirty-three current trials; no protocol roster published.
Feline OSCC Lewritin plus radiation current institution primary agrees with canonical.
Dog melanoma pulmonary metastasis anti-PDL1 current Japanese institutional protocol agrees.
BTX001 TCC, HSA/doxorubicin and OSA pipeline programs lack final current owner cohorts.
Seoul radiotherapy enrollment ended December 13, 2024; already non-matchable.
ACI oral melanoma enrollment explicitly closed; already non-matchable.
Cornell COOL trametinib oral SCC is existing same protocol, not a second trial.
UF Boxer glioma autogenic vaccine current recruitment, existing canonical match.
Sponsor open three sites vs two current university on-hold statuses; conflict retained, no fabricated uniformly active roster.
Oklahoma current routes 404/403; no primary roster obtained or absence-based closure.
Four current VSSO research entries; classifications reconciled, no new eligible treatment intervention.
Veterinary Oncology Services master unavailable via shell and Web; transient server failure recorded without endless retries.
Three Bologna oncology entries explicitly CONCLUSO; already non-matchable.

Mars oncology master JS; official BluePearl fallback prohibited by review and actual shared 403 attempt documented. HIFU lymphoma 140763 primary/managed locations read: Dallas only, five study-covered doxorubicin doses, existing canonical match.
ValiRx Animal Health current pipeline/news describes development, no patient-recruiting treatment trial published.
Four institutional oncology programs including GCN2, cardiac surgery, FLIM and nanobody; current intake details vary/incomplete. Only study drug funding cannot become free care.
Four Japanese research programs; cat proteasome B-cell and canine mutation-positive lung records already added yesterday. Magnetic/IL12 owner-benefit/cohort terms unresolved.
Palladia side effects and nerve-block titles; publisher copied nerve-block body into Palladia page, protocol-specific evidence unavailable rather than silently guessed.
Eight DVG study PDF entries; old individual routes and current provider/cohort statuses not all available.
Edinburgh official current study master unavailable through permitted shell/Web; no inferred zero.
AKS701d/197d/427c/619c pipeline. Newly indexed article is dated October 29, 2025, not new today; first-animal safety alone remains watchlist.

Current hospital trial index: Volition feline diagnostic, IDEXX samples, SOLID relapse and PUSH Akron. Direct local PUSH listing confirms phase-specific funding; sponsor omission recorded, whole sponsor list reconciled separately.

Entire two-protocol master and both individual sponsor primaries read. ECIP-OSA-01 explicitly CLOSED; ECI plus chemotherapy distinct/unfunded and requires enrollment before amputation. Individual primary overrides stale master open label.
